title: Umuziki w'imisozi mu gicugu
intro: Umviriza uko ibiyaya bisubiramwo amashimwe iruhande y’umusavyi wa Allah yatoranijwe. Ijwi ry’ingabire y’umuziki, urubanza ruronderwa n’abaharira mu cumba, n’ivyuma vyoroshe n’itegeko ry’Imana birindiriye kuvumburwa. Ni ikihe kigereranyo c’ugusenga n’ubutegetsi bubereye kivuga biciye muri ivyo bimenyetso?
clues: Nahezagiwe na Allah n’ubuntu n’ijwi ryiza ry’ugushemeza.
Narigishijwe na Allah gutahura ururimi rw’urubanza rubereye hagati y’abatongana.
Nahanganye n’umusirikare w’igihangange mu rugamba kandi ku bushake bwa Allah ndabatsinze.
Nahawe ubwenge, ubukuru n’icanditswe c’amazaburi cahishuriwe kivuye kuri Allah.
Nari kumwe n’imisozi n’inyoni mu guhimbaza Allah kumwe nanje ku mugoroba no ku zuba rirashe.
Narigishijwe na Allah guhingura amakoti y’ivyuma y’ivyuma vyari vyanyorohewe.

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Yarahawe ubwami, ubukerebutsi, n’ivya Zabur (Zaburi) .
Yarahawe umuhungu mu busaza inyuma y’isengesho ry’ubwira .
Yarahawe umutekano mu mwobo imyaka myinshi
Yarahawe isoko rya Zamzam mu bugaragwa .
Ni ukuri ko ingabo zarohamye mu kiyaga .

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
